sections.label: Sleep
sections.text:
Comatose drowsiness ; awakens with hot
head ; dreams of death, mutilated bodies, anxious and
terrible. Horrors in the night. Involuntary stools dur-
ing sleep.

sections.label: Fever
sections.text:
Shivering over whole body. Heat and red-
ness of head, with coolness of rest of body. Internal
heat; feet and hands cold. Nightly sour sweats.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
Worse, least touch; motion; rest; wine;
damp cold. Better, lying down, or with head low.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Vertigo when walking, with tendency to fall
to one side. Distress when head is covered. Nose-
bleed. [Mclilot.; Pry.]

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Aching in eyes. Extravasation of blood in
lids, conjunctiva, aqueous or vitreous. Contused
wounds. Cataract with gout.

sections.label: Face
sections.text:
Red pimples on forehead and checks: stinging
when touched. Crusty eruption around nose and mouth.

sections.label: Mouth
sections.text:
Dry. retching with eructation. Musty taste
with catarrhal affection.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Burning in nose. Cough, with bloody
expectoration. Dyspnoea: chest feels constricted. Suf-


focative arrest of breathing. Haemoptysis, alternating
with rheumatism. Chest hurts when touched. Whoop-
ing-cough ; spasmodic, double inspiration with sobbing.

sections.label: Rectum
sections.text: Anal fissures. Hacmorrhoidal pain.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Gouty pains shoot all through the foot
and limb, and in joints, but especially small joints.
Swollen, hot, pale. Throbbing in right shoulder. Pres-
sure in shoulder, worse motion. Cracking in joints;
worse, warmth of bed. Gouty nodosities. Ball of
great toe swollen. [Bothrops.] Rheumatism begins in
lower limbs and ascends. [Kolmia opposite.] Ankles
sw'ollen. Soles painful, can hardly step on them. [Ant.
c.; Lyc.] Easy spraining of ankle.

from depressing emotions or bad news ; in relaxation of the genital

again in some features of the headaches. They are accompanied by
blurring of the sight, and relieved by a copious discharge of watery
